description: This file defines the ConfigConfigurator class in the Drupal core system, responsible for managing configuration storage and comparison for recipes, including importing config from extensions and ensuring consistency between active and recipe configurations.

classes.name: ConfigConfigurator
classes.description: Final class responsible for configuring and validating configuration data for Drupal recipes, including importing, strict comparison, and configuration validation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes configuration, determines config directory, and validates existing configuration against the recipe.

methods.name: getConfigStorage
methods.description: Returns a StorageInterface object for reading configuration, considering import extensions and strict mode.

methods.name: hasTasks
methods.description: Checks if the recipe has any configuration or actions to apply.
